d.title: Asobi ni Iku yo!: Asobi ni Oide - Owari
d.jp: あそびにいくヨ! あそびにおいで おわり
d.synopsis: Kio Kakazu is having a good time with a Catian Assistroid, a robot from the planet Catia that helps with tasks. By showing different pictures from an album, Kio teaches the little robot the importance of memories.

rel.name: Asobi ni Iku yo!: Asobi ni Oide
